user.title: Connect Eufy Viewer bridge
user.description: Enter the address and access token of your dedicated Eufy Viewer bridge. The bridge must already be running. No cameras will be started.

account.title: Sign in to Eufy
account.description: Use a dedicated Eufy account with shared access to your cameras. Credentials are stored on your local bridge, not in this Home Assistant entry.

verify.title: Verification code
verify.description: Enter the verification code sent by Eufy.

captcha.title: Complete the captcha
captcha.description:
![Captcha]({captcha_image})

Enter the characters shown in the image.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot communicate with the bridge. Check its address and connection.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the credentials or verification code.

abort.wrong_bridge: This endpoint belongs to a different bridge. Add it as a separate integration.
abort.invalid_bridge_auth: The bridge rejected its access token. Start setup again with the correct token.

snapshot_refresh_capability_unavailable.message: This camera cannot refresh its snapshot on its current connection.

snapshot_refresh_not_connected.message: The bridge is not connected to Eufy. Wait until it reconnects and try again.

snapshot_refresh_recording_busy.message: A recording is being prepared. Try again when it has finished.

snapshot_refresh_live_stopping.message: The previous live session is still stopping. Try again in a few seconds.

snapshot_refresh_station_limit.message: Another camera on this HomeBase is live. Close that live view first.

snapshot_refresh_camera_busy.message: The camera cannot start another live session now. Close a live view and try again.

snapshot_refresh_refresh_timeout.message: The camera sent no picture in time. Check its connection and battery, then try again.

snapshot_refresh_refresh_failed.message: The camera stopped before it sent a picture. Try again.

snapshot_refresh_not_found.message: The bridge does not know this camera. Check that it is still shared with the bridge's Eufy account.

snapshot_refresh_failed.message: Could not refresh the snapshot. Check the bridge connection and try again.

preset_capability_unavailable.message: This camera cannot move to a preset on its current connection.

preset_not_connected.message: The bridge is not connected to Eufy. No move was sent.

preset_not_sent.message: The bridge could not reach the HomeBase. No move was sent.

preset_station_busy.message: The HomeBase is busy with live view, a recording or another command. Try again in a few seconds.

preset_unconfirmed.message: The HomeBase did not confirm the move. The camera may still have moved.

preset_not_found.message: The bridge does not know this camera.

preset_failed.message: Could not move the camera to the preset. Check the bridge connection.
